articles.summary: Ecolab today announced it is convening an open AI infrastructure ecosystem to solve the data center industry’s need for faster next-generation data center development. Today at SC26, the company launched the ecosystem with a leading group of technology, manufacturing and service partners, each of whom play a distinct role, to help data center operators move more quickly from design to production while improving performance, uptime, energy efficiency and reducing water use. Today’s announcements are part of a broader plan to lead in the development of the industry’s most advanced AI infrastructure. articles.summary: New platform uniquely connects advanced liquid cooling hardware, intelligent fluid management, digital technology and global service to maximize computing performance and accelerate AI infrastructure deployment Ecolab today unveiled a first-of-its-kind integrated cooling platform that brings together technologies and expertise traditionally managed separately, helping AI data centers deploy faster, maximize computing performance and dramatically improve water and energy efficiency. Introduced at SC26 in Chicago, the platform uniquely connects CoolIT's advanced direct liquid cooling hardware with Ecolab's industry-leading fluid management expertise, digital intelligence and global service capabilities. At its center is Ecolab's 3D TRASAR™ technology integrated into the new CoolIT CHx™ 3000, a 3-megawatt coolant distribution unit, making this the first smart thermal management system for direct liquid cooling.
